title: TopoST: Topology-Conditioned Node Specialization for Urban Spatio-Temporal Foundation Models
abstract: arXiv:2611.15440v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Urban spatio-temporal foundation models must share knowledge across diverse urban scenarios while accommodating heterogeneous node dynamics. Our analysis of 20+ datasets spanning diverse urban scenarios reveals recurring local graph structures across datasets alongside substantial node heterogeneity within local subgraphs. Motivated by these observations, we propose TopoST, which combines shared learning over local subgraphs with topology-conditioned node specialization. The key insight is to make node specialization itself transferable through a shared topology-to-parameter mapping. This mapping uses identity-independent topological representations to generate node-specific temporal and spatial dependency parameters, enabling direct specialization for unseen nodes without target-specific embeddings or model updates. Extensive experiments demonstrate that TopoST achieves remarkable zero-shot generalization across unseen cities and task

translated_title: TopoST：面向城市时空基础模型的拓扑条件节点特化
translated_abstract: 城市时空基础模型需要在多样化的城市场景之间共享知识，同时适应异构的节点动态。我们对涵盖多种城市场景的20多个数据集进行分析后发现，不同数据集中存在反复出现的局部图结构，同时局部子图内部存在显著的节点异质性。基于这些观察，我们提出了TopoST，它将局部子图上的共享学习与拓扑条件化的节点特化相结合。其核心洞察在于：通过一个共享的拓扑到参数映射，使节点特化本身具备可迁移性。该映射利用与身份无关的拓扑表示来生成节点特定的时空依赖参数，从而无需针对目标节点的特定嵌入或模型更新，即可直接对未见节点进行特化。大量实验表明，TopoST在未见过的城市和任务上实现了出色的零样本泛化能力。
tldr: TopoST通过共享的拓扑到参数映射实现可迁移的节点特化，无需目标特定嵌入或模型更新，即可在未见城市和任务上取得出色的零样本泛化能力。
en_tdlr: TopoST achieves transferable node specialization through a shared topology-to-parameter mapping, enabling strong zero-shot generalization to unseen cities and tasks without target-specific embeddings or model updates.
